title: 第一卷第13章 觉醒命星第一卷第14章 一时无敌
content_zh:
;;
君无邪回到猎人公会时，小月瑶正在睡觉。
他坐在床前，守了她整整一天。
两次饭点，她都没醒。
“月瑶怎么会这么嗜睡？”
他感觉有些不正常，找到秦可清询问了一番。
秦可清告诉他，这两日，小月瑶都比较嗜睡。
“你们这半年在萧家过得应该不好吧？”秦可清叹了叹，道：“听说你没有恢复之前，她每日都去城外给你采药是吗？”
君无邪点了点头，心里一痛。
“她太小了，长期严重营养不良，又日日劳作，估计是留下了隐疾。以后有条件，你找个医师给她好好看看吧。”
……
君无邪守着小月瑶，她睡到半夜才醒来，吃了些东西，没多久，她又睡了。
“前辈，我妹妹她是怎么回事？”
君无邪进入永生神殿，向神秘女子求助。
“她的情况很不好，不过暂时还没事，你想要救她的话，需尽快给他找到高明的医师。”
君无邪心一紧：“有……有这么严重？”
“不错，可能会有性命之忧。你想救她，那就抓紧时间修炼，打败萧旭，得到大河海选令，加入大河剑宗。在那样的宗门里，应该有能治疗她的医师。”
“我知道了！”
君无邪深深吸了口气，排除了心里的杂念，服下大量的初灵丹，磅礴的灵气转为了血精，淬炼与滋养着肉身。
五日之后。

极境累积到了顶点，他踏入了兵冢，承受着生不如死的锻打，突破到了极境小圆满境界，肉身强度再上层楼。
之后，他离开永生神殿，看到小月瑶有秦可清照顾着，便放下心来，再次进入永生神殿，服下小灵丹，继续修炼。
小灵丹的效果比初灵丹强数倍，这可是真正的一星下品灵丹。
有足够的资源，他决心要一举突破到先天境！
又过了七日，极境小圆满累积到了顶点，再次进入兵冢，开始冲关极境最后的大圆满之境。
时间过得很快。
不知不觉，君无邪在永生神殿里快二十日了，身上所有的灵丹消耗一空。
这日夜晚，天空漆黑，看不到星辰，也没有月亮。
可渐渐的，密密麻麻的星辰出现了，无比的璀璨，将黑夜照得近乎跟白昼一般。
无尽的星海，呈现出了壮阔惊人的景象。
那些星辰居然转动了起来，仿佛在它们的中心有个轴，且靠近中央的星辰，一颗一颗在分解，仿佛正在被吞噬。
那些星光向着中央汇聚，那里如同有个深渊漩涡，将所有星辰都分解与吞噬掉了。
这样的景象惊动了整个青阳城，惊动了整个大周国，惊动了整个东荒，整个天下！
……
永生神殿内，君无邪皱着眉头，他感应到了本命星辰，可是却看不到它，这让他很是疑惑。
他确定自己的本命星辰就在万星拱卫的漩涡中央，但却看不到，像是掉进了那漆黑的虚空深渊里。
“前辈，这是怎么回事？”
君无邪有些急了，他怀疑是不是突破出了问题。
“低等的命星再璀璨也上不了台面，至强的命星能吞噬万星、吞噬光，除非有强大的瞳术，否则是看不见的。”

When Jun Wuxie returned to the Hunter Guild, Xiao Yueyao was sleeping.
He sat in front of the bed and watched her for the whole day.
She didn't wake up during the two meals.
"Why is Yueyao so lethargic?"
He felt something was abnormal, so he went to Qin Keqing and asked about it.
Qin Keqing told him that Xiao Yueyao had been sleepy these past two days.
"You must have had a hard time in the Xiao family these past six months, right?" Qin Keqing sighed and said, "I heard that before you recovered, she went outside the city every day to collect medicine for you, right?"
Jun Wuxie nodded, feeling a pain in his heart.
"She is too young. She has been severely malnourished for a long time and worked hard every day. She may have hidden diseases. If possible, you can find a doctor to take a good look at her."
…
Jun Wuxie guarded Xiao Yueyao. She slept until midnight before waking up and eating something. Not long after, she fell asleep again.
"Senior, what happened to my sister?"
Jun Wuxie entered the Temple of Eternal Life and asked the mysterious woman for help.
"Her condition is very bad, but she is fine for the time being. If you want to save her, you need to find a skilled doctor for her as soon as possible."
Jun Wuxie's heart tightened: "Is... is it so serious?"
"Yes, your life may be in danger. If you want to save her, then seize the time to practice, defeat Xiao Xu, get the Dahe Sea Selection Order, and join the Dahe Sword Sect. In such a sect, there should be a doctor who can treat her."
"I know!"
Jun Wuxie took a deep breath, eliminated the distracting thoughts in his heart, and took a large amount of the First Spirit Pill. The majestic spiritual energy turned into blood essence, refining and nourishing the physical body.
Five days later.
The accumulation of extreme levels reached its peak. He stepped into the military tomb and endured a beating that was worse than life. He broke through to the small perfection level of the extreme level, and his physical strength increased to a new level.
After that, he left the Eternal Life Temple and saw that Xiao Yueyao was being taken care of by Qin Keqing. He felt relieved and entered the Eternal Life Temple again, took the Xiaoling Pill and continued to practice.
The effect of the Little Spirit Pill is several times stronger than that of the First Spirit Pill. This is a real one-star low-grade Spirit Pill.
With enough resources, he is determined to break through to the Xiantian realm in one fell swoop!
After another seven days, the accumulation of Small Perfection in the Extreme Realm reached its peak, and he entered the Soldier Tomb again and began to rush towards the final Great Perfection in the Extreme Realm.
Time flies.
Unknowingly, Jun Wuxie had been in the Temple of Eternal Life for almost twenty days, and all the elixirs in his body were exhausted.
That night, the sky was dark, no stars could be seen, and there was no moon.
But gradually, dense stars appeared, extremely bright, illuminating the night almost like day.
The endless sea of ​​stars presents a magnificent and astonishing sight.
Those stars actually started to rotate, as if there was an axis in their center, and the stars near the center were disintegrating one by one, as if they were being swallowed.
Those starlights converged towards the center, where there seemed to be an abyss whirlpool, disintegrating and swallowing up all the stars.
Such a scene shocked the entire Qingyang City, the entire Great Zhou Kingdom, the entire Eastern Wasteland, and the entire world!
…
In the Temple of Eternal Life, Jun Wuxie frowned. He sensed his natal star, but couldn't see it, which made him very confused.
He was sure that his natal star was in the center of the whirlpool surrounded by thousands of stars, but he couldn't see it, as if he had fallen into the dark abyss of the void.
"Senior, what's going on?"
Jun Wuxie was a little anxious. He wondered if there was something wrong with the breakthrough.
"A low-level life star cannot be on the stage no matter how bright it is. The most powerful life star can swallow up thousands of stars and light. Unless you have a powerful pupil technique, you can't see it."
